bends.reason: bend_01 section: the registered scan turns at the bend line and follows the blue FORMED flange to its tip (~9 mm leg, ~90 deg, on the same side as the CAD flange); no scan points on the orange flat continuation. Global views agree: raw SIDE cross-section is an L with exactly one ~90 deg radiused leg; raw TOP shows that flange edge-on as a dense strip along the full length of one long edge; raw FRONT shows its face (chamfered left end, as in CAD); overlay (registration OK) puts the leg on the B1 line.
